field_principles.actions_delta_ci: bootstrap CI on the actions delta; efficiency claim requires the CI to exclude zero.
field_principles.chosen_submitted_config: recommend enable predictor-ranker when successful; unchanged if null.
field_principles.efficiency_score_min_human_agent_sq: min(human/agent,1)^2 with the human baseline from replay corpus.
field_principles.false_negative_risk_checked: a no-value null is valid only if the positive control passed.
field_principles.generic_transfer_rate_with_predictor: held-out variant transfer WITH the predictor vs the 0.04 baseline.
field_principles.inference_substrate: verifier_ensemble_against_cached_candidates -- the CNN trains/scores against cached transitions (no LLM load, 1s floor); fast CPU forward pass declared.
field_principles.median_actions_to_first_levelup_baseline: the blind-BFS baseline, measured the SAME way.
field_principles.median_actions_to_first_levelup_with_pre: the HEADLINE -- held-out median actions-to-first-levelup with the predictor-ranked explorer.
field_principles.missing_verifier_gaps: if no gain, record residual generation/ranking gap.
field_principles.null_delta_methodology_note: present when actions_delta==0.0 -- honest no-gain null, not a measurement bug.
field_principles.offline_reproduced: any newly-solved variant must offline-reproduce to count.
field_principles.positive_control_passed: learnable-clickability control where predictor-ranking must beat blind.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: records resources verified (offline arcade, torch, LOCAL corpora).
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: content-addressed hash catches silent corpus/model drift on replay.
field_principles.solve_rate_preserved: HARD gate -- efficiency win must NOT drop solve-rate.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: MUST be false -- learned action-effect model is oracle-DISTINCT from executable win-check.

inference_substrate_correction_note: CORRECTED 2026-08-28 by the outer loop (ARC artifact lint debt repair, class a; ops/known-issues.md 2026-08-29). The original value was the legal substrate name 'verifier_ensemble_against_cached_candidates' followed by a trailing human note. That form follows the '<canonical value><separator><human note>' convention that scripts/determination_preservation_lint.py documents, but scripts/arc_artifact_lint.py exact-matches and returned INVALID_INFERENCE_SUBSTRATE on it. The substrate MEANING is unchanged. The full original string is preserved verbatim in inference_substrate_original_invalid_value. No measurement field was touched.
inference_substrate_original_invalid_val: verifier_ensemble_against_cached_candidates -- the CNN trains/scores against cached transitions (no LLM load, 1s floor); fast CPU forward pass declared.
missing_verifier_gaps: predictor ranking did not put a newly winning action into the held-out pool earlier
candidate generation remains the residual bottleneck if the winner is absent
null_delta_methodology_note: actions_delta==0.0 from matched held-out candidate groups; this is an honest no-gain null rather than a control==best tautology.
